info.title: bmo-cache-siren
info.description: A live watch of prompt-cache hits and new tokens per model request, sounding a siren when new tokens jump. It tails harness transcripts and takes the usage a runner posts; a watched session is a harness session named by sessionId with its modelName. It calls no other service. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys; times are integers of epoch milliseconds. A page is items and more. Every failure is answered in the error shape with its status. The pages and their assets are its own screen (x-pages), outside the API. The harness plugin's tools, each a thin call of one route, are stated under x-tools.

x-harness.entry: A harness reads how well its own prompt cache is holding with cache_stats and widens or narrows the siren with cache_settings_update.

requestLabel.description: A short label of what prompted the request.

scope.description: The poster's own grouping, never read.

labels.description: The poster's own metadata, never read.

Usage.description: One request, limit, notice, command or compact, read from a transcript or posted by a runner.

oneOf.description: New tokens under the yellow line: a normal cache hit.
A cache read with new tokens at or past the yellow line: a big read, many tool results.
The first request of a session.
A seen session that read nothing back and took new tokens at or past the yellow line.
A safeguard fallback to another model, so the next request re-prefills everything.
A session, weekly or spend limit.
A compact boundary or a summary.
An API error other than a limit.
A notice the CLI wrote in place of an answer.
A local command, such as `/model` or `/effort`.
A posted request whose usage is unknown.
The new tokens of the burst window past the burst line.

more.description: Whether anything stands past the last item.

EventPage.description: A page of events, oldest first.

reason.description: Why the service is not ready; null when it is.

at.description: When the request went out, in epoch milliseconds.

NewUsage.description: The usage of one model request, as a runner posts it.

since.description: The time the sums start, in epoch milliseconds.

Stats.description: Cache hits and new tokens by session since a time.

cachedShare.description: Cached over cached and new tokens; null with neither.

SessionStats.description: One session's sums over the window.

SettingsPatch.description: A merge patch of the settings: a field given as null or left out stays.

sounded.description: Whether sound or voice went out.

SirenTest.description: One sounding of the siren to test it.

code.description: A kebab-case code that means one thing in every service.

error.description: A sentence naming what is wrong.

WireError.description: Every failure: a non-2xx status with exactly these two keys.

Error.description:
A failure, in the common error shape. The codes:
- `bad-request` (400): the body or the query is not the shape the route takes
- `unauthorized` (401): the bearer token is missing or wrong
- `no-route` (404): no route answers this method and path
- `conflict` (409): a settings change the settings as they stand do not allow
- `gone` (410): a resume from before the event window
- `too-large` (413): the body is over 65536 bytes
- `failed` (500): the service failed

bearer.description: The content of the service's token file.
